To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) content-area teachers who seek ELL preparation do not have to be positive about ELLs, and (b) the decision to seek ELL preparation is motivated by the perceived value of preparation, consistency with teachers‘ personal beliefs and self-concepts, as well as expected success in the experience.

Content area teachers seeking ELL preparation are primarily motivated to enroll in a course for the perceived value of the course for immediate or future professional goals, for consistency with their self-concept, and for the expected success they will have in the learning experience.
